title: Add missing Zustand selectors
action: Add 3 missing targeted selectors to stores/selectors.ts: useSelectConversation, useCheckBackend, useBackendStatus
implementation:
In src/stores/selectors.ts, add 3 new selector hooks following existing patterns:
1. `export const useSelectConversation = () => useAppStore((s) => s.selectConversation)`
2. `export const useCheckBackend = () => useAppStore((s) => s.checkBackend)`
3. `export const useBackendStatus = () => useAppStore((s) => s.backendStatus)`
